title: Refactor callbacks to async/await then add retry wrapper in TypeScript — 3 turns
description: Callback-based code refactored to async/await, tests kept green, retry wrapper added.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `fetchUser(id: number): Promise<...>` in `src/dataService.ts` by wrapping `fetchUserCb` in a Promise: `return new Promise((resolve, reject) => fetchUserCb(id, (err, result) => err ? reject(err) : resolve(result!)))`. Run `npm test -- --forceExit`.
followup_prompts: Run `npm test -- --forceExit` to confirm no regressions. Now implement `saveUser(user)` the same way using `saveUserCb`. Also review the code — is the promisification pattern clean? Give me a one-line summary of what changed.

Final pass: implement `withRetry<T>(fn, maxRetries)` — try fn(), if it throws and we have retries left, try again. After maxRetries+1 total attempts, re-throw. Then run `npm test -- --forceExit` and confirm everything is green — all 7 tests must pass.
success_criteria: fetchUser wraps callback in Promise correctly
saveUser wraps callback in Promise correctly
withRetry retries on failure up to maxRetries times
